description: HUD-listed LIHTC properties still monitored for compliance, in one state, optionally one city and a name or street fragment, largest first. Each result has its lihtc.loans page URL and HUD project id for get_property. Covers cities with 5 or more monitored properties.

city.description: City name as HUD lists it, e.g. "Los Angeles"

name.description: Words from the property name or street address

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code (CA, DC, PR) or name
